title: P1: remediate pre-existing dependency vulnerabilities
body: A complete diagnostic audit using DEVAI PR #413 found 37 advisories: 5 critical, 15 high, 13 moderate, 4 low. The exact pre-upgrade manifests at 57ca183f have identical advisory IDs and severities; no advisory was introduced by DEVAI adoption. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-599161f9/dependency-audit-comparison.json and evidence-manifest.json. Owner: Architect for remediation choices; Engineer for a separate product PR. Keep sensor thresholds unchanged; rerun the complete audit after remediation. The unpublished-provider diagnostic is not an official scorecard reading.
resolution: C1 PR206 R-0037/PC-0023; C2 PR208 11eea2d7309a958d14d536ea7ced46124dfeed2e R-0038/PC-0024; work/rounds/R-0038/reports/post-integration/verification.json

title: P2: remediate product lint findings revealed by complete measurement
body: The complete diagnostic run with DEVAI PR #413 parsed 3498 files and reported 1135 errors and 1 warning, with zero parser errors. Existing app rules are preserved; enablement changes configure discovery and parser roots only. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-599161f9/evidence-manifest.json and candidate-provider diagnostics. Owner: Engineer; fix product violations in a separate PR without weakening or disabling rules. Do not classify these as enablement regressions merely because the previous sensor could not complete; compare each finding with its source history. The diagnostic is not an official published-provider verdict.

title: P2: investigate slow historical main-branch CI
body: Native published DEVAI 2.6.2 measured 91 push/main runs, 89 successful. CI duration median 1684 seconds and p95 2280 seconds exceed the unchanged pass limits of 900 and 1800 seconds. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-599161f9/evidence-manifest.json. Base-branch population verification remains a provider limitation addressed separately in codex/detran-ci-population-20261018. Owner: Engineer. After population verification, profile actual CI steps and submit a separate optimization PR. Preserve mandatory checks, sample minima, observation window and duration thresholds.

title: P2: investigate two reproducible SENATRAN mock E2E contract mismatches
body: Published DEVAI 2.6.2 native E2E at 8cf4223a completed with 1853 passed and 2 failed: national-extensions.e2e.spec.ts CDT recognition expects 200 and receives 402; renach-workflow.e2e.spec.ts exam idempotency expects 201 and receives 402. A separate full replay at diagnostic commit 90dc922b resets the existing mock seed before every test file and reproduces both mismatches, so cross-file contamination is not a sufficient explanation. Product sources, assertions and timeouts are unchanged. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-8cf4223a/evidence-manifest.json. Owner: Inspector to capture the actual error envelope and compare the seeded business state; Engineer/Architect to remediate the established fixture or product cause in a separate PR. Preserve original failed readings and no weakening of assertions. Do not call either failure an enablement regression without source-history evidence.

title: P2 Inspector: improve product unit coverage and sparse package tests
body: Separate product test work. Increase whole-source local unit coverage from the evidence-backed baseline, prioritize sparse packages from coverage-by-package.json and test_coherence, and disposition existing TODOs through the product workflow. Retain all existing assertions, timeouts, native 80/50 coverage thresholds and original package coverage gates. Do not claim integration/E2E or RC coverage from the local-unit report. Respect the separate unapproved P4 planning boundary. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-e9e45a4a/evaluation-register.json; frozen candidate e9e45a4a6cbed5cfd394c716c79a55b1aca386b8.

title: P1 Architect: resolve static RBAC inventory mappings and PII classifications
body: Separate architecture/security assessment and any subsequent product fixes. Resolve statically unbound endpoint authorization against actual guards/policies and classify name-based PII candidates. An unresolved static role is not proof an endpoint is unprotected; an unlabeled name-based candidate is not proof of a legal violation. Preserve tenant/RLS request roles and SENATRAN adapter boundaries. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-e9e45a4a/evaluation-register.json; frozen candidate e9e45a4a6cbed5cfd394c716c79a55b1aca386b8.

body: Separate governance/harness work from measurement enablement. Address seven gate invariants lacking measurable_via entries, evaluate workflow action-version drift and concurrency policy, and assess composite/reusable workflow advisories on merit.
